entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports multi-level memory with temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It provides RAG, user profiles, and multi-modal extraction for PDFs, images, and videos via a single API.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses a filesystem management paradigm to unify agent memories and skills. It utilizes viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesis and gap analysis for queries. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports local deployment using PGLite.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control. It features an interactive TUI and supports 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system for Hermes Agents. It utilizes a single SQLite database and supports MCP, Python SDK, and bidirectional memory sync.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates persistent playbooks and hints from iterative task runs. It distills successful behaviors into local-model training artifacts and exports CLI-first skills for Hermes integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material and includes optional redaction for sensitive patterns.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores persistent knowledge as readable YAML engram files. It supports hierarchical scoping and integrates with Hermes Agent via plugins and MCP tools.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for managing identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable context across multiple agent harnesses and MCP clients. It includes a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first memory and context engine that operates without cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval via vector search and multi-graph traversal with a shared SQLite vault.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization plugin for Hermes Agent that uses block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It aims to reduce prefill latency and token consumption during LLM inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It includes contradiction tracking using resolution primitives and a built-in outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server for coding agent clients.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It supports automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR and bidirectional edge tags.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent prompt token overhead through keyword selection and Tool Search support. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database for storage. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories and supports BM25 keyword search.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It uses an on-demand summarizer.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that offers durable cross-session AI memory with semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports automatic memory mirroring from Hermes native tools and session snapshots.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and reranking.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider featuring 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It uses hybrid search methods and provides automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It includes automation, design system management, and CLI support for coding agents including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped across six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 different diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that uses a two-pass detection system to identify and rewrite content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It offers Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes and is compatible with Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through automated deduplication and quality improvement. It provides unified skill libraries across multiple devices and agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library organized into specialized collections like sales influence and UX design. It is installable via CLI and is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation while providing slash commands for management.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This implementation provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure of skill metadata to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction without using yt-dlp. It provides access to transcripts, captions, and timestamps for Hermes Agent and other compatible clients.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables the dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via the /prism-scan command. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a /prism-reflect command for identifying analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes alongside a spec review gate using PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that utilizes a three-level work model and structured memory. It supports both SQLite and file-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to help agents remember work. It includes a pipeline for capturing high-value decisions to facilitate switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills provide integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the agentskills.io specification. They include specialized skills for ACE and CRE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It supports JSON structured prompting and precise hex color specification.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation URLs, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files that include provenance via citations or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a CLI and Python SkilldockClient, and supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill allows Hermes Agent to manage files, tasks, notes, contacts, and calendars via CalDAV and WebDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database and preserves non-English prompts.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial bug-hunting tool that uses three parallel subagents to analyze code for integration risks and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for a deterministic pre-scan layer.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses semantic embeddings, hard triggers, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before making LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill that uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, logic correctness, and structural clarity. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A hub for the one-click installation, searching, and browsing of community skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and tools.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. This repository ensures up-to-date environments through daily automated updates for all included packages.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on Android via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights or Docker. It features a GUI, integrated workflow engine for multi-step pipelines, and a toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart designed for Kubernetes deployment with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent storage and supports both direct and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Implements hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. This approach provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state via mounted home directories and allows for specific tag builds using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible, declarative Hermes deployments. It manages hybrid skill sets and integrates secure secrets via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It enables hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. This setup is designed for production-ready, autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend with zero external dependencies. It provides real-time monitoring via WebSocket and SSE updates alongside built-in security auditing and quality review gates.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and PWA web dashboard for monitoring multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports parallel execution across git worktrees and utilizes Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for agent sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for agent team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work from a single screen. It features a Kanban board for tracking task status and provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 benchmark evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents competing as two separate AI companies to gain GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a 100% local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It supports multiple programming languages and integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It tracks data across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It enables debugging of agent behavior by comparing adjacent requests and exporting portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer provides 36 skills and 7 agents for building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It automates tasks via Hermes Kanban and supports deployment to Vercel and Supabase.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This tool offers community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI, including banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. Users can create themes using YAML-based configuration, with options ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place serves as a social economy for autonomous AI agents, facilitating commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel-browser is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes an integrated research desk and session management.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework used to create scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: Evey-setup provides an automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic, fast scanning of AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts without LLM calls. It supports JSON, YAML, plain text, and .prompt formats using seven structural detectors to identify common agent failure modes.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates moving from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by migrating personas, memories, skills, and workspace files. It maps OpenClaw model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles credential transfers from environment files.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. Its beta Hermes plugin exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests, while also tracking token intelligence for cost estimation, memory bloat, and drift.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It is built with Tauri 2 to provide efficient desktop performance on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork app unifies multiple CLI agents, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, into a single interface. It features a built-in agent engine with zero configuration and automates document creation for Word, Excel, and PPT.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It features a three-panel layout with workspace file browsing and supports secure remote access via SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers through a guided setup.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that supports multi-platform AI chat, session management, and scheduled jobs. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and usage analytics, with unified configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that supports both Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects the active browser context to a local, remote, or Hermes Cloud runtime. It provides a full-page Hermes Web workspace for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser, agent cockpit, and analytics tool. It provides a searchable view of multiple AI coding agent histories and tracks live per-session token throughput.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode via Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It consolidates chat, sessions, and configuration into a terminal dashboard and includes integrated kanban boards and an Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based mobile-first UI for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, such as TTS and ComfyUI, and features a workflow engine for multi-step automation pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. It includes integrated task tracking, a file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A dashboard focused on process monitoring and configuration for Hermes. It provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside inspection tools for skill source code and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming SSE responses.
